# Copilot setup

- `AGENTS.md`: repository scope, commands, review and safety rules.
- `.github/copilot-instructions.md`: repository Copilot entry point.
- `.github/instructions/source.instructions.md`: source-specific safety guidance.
- `.github/agent-policy.json`: small public-repository review-role declaration.
- `PenniLogic/.github/agents`: shared Developer, Producer, QA and specialist profiles.
- `.github/github-app.yml`: manual commands only; the app must review/trust it.
- `.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml`: standard hosted cloud-agent setup.

`CONSTITUTION.md` is explicitly referenced documentation, not an automatically
discovered filename. Cloud setup config does not grant a Copilot subscription,
prove that an agent ran, or authorize spending. No automatic remote control,
credential hook, self-hosted runner or custom status publisher is configured.
